p.s: ` Jack of all trades and master of none'
I believe if one day my mom tries to make cookies with the methods of making cakes, puddings, ice-creames etc. all together it would taste rather ridiculous.
Try and imagine a person wearing a white shirt entirely covered with circles of red, green, purple and blue.
Iam sure it reminds of a clown.
on the other hand imagine a persson with white shirt and tiny scattered red and blue squares; looks assum.

Similarly if a person has broad knowledge of many academic subjects and no deep knowledge in any specific of them then it could not be put to any specific use; and if tried to use in some way would actually spoil things.

Consider an example wherein the teacher of history in the lecture while explaining about civil war starts relating it opera it would rather lead to a rather useless junk of thoughts in the students mind.
In order to be able to apply the knowledge one has gained to some practical use deeper knowledge regarding the same is required.
This is neccesary in oredr to ensure that what we do will be flawless.
A student to stand up strongly in future is no doubt has to be versed with everything under the sun.
But the depth of such knowledge has to be limited and whereas knowledge in one particular area has to be really strong.
Now is wan era wherein the complexity in various fieldfs is increasing ten fold and so is the avancement.
To keep pace with both of them what is neccesary is specialisation.
It has been observed for this matter that post-graduates and more precisely doctorates are in graeater demand in professional world than are mere graduates.
This is due to the fact that they definetely hold more depper, more preicse and absolutely flawless knowledge in order to be apllied directly.

Also the apllication point of view for their field is more clear Thus, although one should have knowledge about what is going around and whats in, it is also essential that he is able to get the deeepest possible knowledge in a particular field and apply the same in oredr to stand up strongly and more confidently in the professional world.
